evidence: Python tomllib parses task.toml (schema_version 1.4; [verifier.env] frozen block lines 30-35), tests/scoring.toml (gates render/constraints 0.0, weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, floor functional 0.05) and all five judge.toml files; every criterion has id/name/type/weight/description (visual adds points=5), no duplicate ids. Beyond syntax, rewardkit 0.1.7's own loader (rewardkit.runner.discover, run read-only with --network none in the existing brickfall-tests:2.0.1 image built from the same template tests/Dockerfile) loaded the frozen /tests/gates and /tests/scored: constraints AgentJudge 2, render 1, functional 43, polish 6, visual 3 criteria, matching the 55 [[criterion]] blocks counted. bash -n passes on solution/solve.sh and tests/test.sh (both #!/bin/bash); a byte scan of every file in the frozen task found no CR and no BOM. tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/scoring.toml and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff -q), and score.py/restart_mcp.py compile. Every prompt.md carries exactly one {app_context} placeholder that test.sh lines 195-201 substitute. Reference entry: node --check passes on solution/app/server.js and public/assets/index.js (the built bundle referenced by public/index.html line 1); src/custom-editor.js is ESM vite source (passes as .mjs) and not a runtime entry. server.js requires only express and better-sqlite3, which both images install globally via NODE_PATH, honours PORT/DB_PATH (lines 8, 142), matching instruction.md line 5 and integration.md lines 3-9. seed_data.json, package.json, package-lock.json and tsconfig.json parse as JSON. Would-run evidence: raw-evidence-index (hashes verified) records run_golden.sh executing this exact solve.sh in the agent image and launching server.js the test.sh way (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH) with all scripted checks passing including a real restart (results/restart.json); the frozen solution is byte-identical (diff --strip-trailing-cr) to the one run_golden.sh mounts. Timeout nesting is consistent: gates 600+600 sequential <= 1500, scored 9000+900+900=10800 <= 11100, total 12600 <= verifier 13200. Broken-app probe: a submission without /app/server.js or with escaping symlinks scores the zero-reward JSON by design (test.sh 68-83), so a parse/launch defect cannot be masked as a pass; conforming-alternative probe: the brief publicly states the node /app/server.js entry, port 3000 and DB_PATH, so a conforming app is not rejected by the launch contract. Out of row scope and not claimed: no full configured-judge (claude-code + glm) run exists on these v16 bytes (only v15 hosted runs: Oracle 1.0, nop 0); that gap belongs to the runtime/workload rows, not to well-formedness.
